# scripts/host/Install-CommandCtrlAgent.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Runs ON an AVD session host VM: downloads the CommandCTRL agent from the media account with the VM's own managed identity, verifies its SHA-256, and enforces multi-session privacy defaults.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-MediaAccountName` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-Blob` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-Sha256` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-Mode` | string | no | `'Install'` |  |
| `-SamplingIntervalSeconds` | int | no | `60` |  |
| `-DisableHistory` | string | no | `'true'` |  |
| `-StorageSuffix` | string | no | `'core.windows.net'` |  |
| `-Destination` | string | no | `'C:\ProgramData\avd-liquidware\media'` |  |
| `-StateFile` | string | no | `'C:\ProgramData\avd-liquidware\commandctrl-state.json'` |  |
